## modelsummary

```{r}
library(modelsummary);library(tidyverse)
library(survival) # Contains the 'pbc' dataset
pbc2 <- 
pbc %>%
    filter(!is.na(trt)) %>%
    mutate(trt = ifelse(trt == 1, "D-penicillmain", "placebo")) %>%
    select(trt, Age = age, Sex = sex, Ascites = ascites, `Alkaline phosphatase` = alk.phos, Stage = stage)
    
pbc2 %>%
    datasummary_balance(~trt, data = .)

# We see now that Stage and Ascites are interpreted as numeric variables, when in fact, they are categorical
pbc2 %>%
    mutate(across(c(Stage, Ascites), as.factor)) %>%
    datasummary_balance(~trt, data = ., output = 'html')
```
